equipment_type: Digital water mixing station (DHW tempering valve)
applies_to: Powers IntelliStation 2 and 2S digital hot-water mixing stations for building domestic hot water systems.
summary: IntelliStation 2 is a Powers (Watts) electronic DHW mixing station. Its control speaks BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP (or Modbus RTU), chosen in the BAS menu. The object list is short: temperatures, pressures, flows, valve position, energy, an error code, recirculation pump and isolation valve status, and one writable mixed outlet setpoint.
notes: Published under the Powers brand (Watts); the PICS lists vendor Powers Control Systems Ltd., vendor ID 834.
Pressure, flow and some temperature points need the matching sensor options fitted.
AV 0 is limited to 60 °F up to the Remote Setpoint Max set at the control (read back on AI 10).
AI 13 returns a numeric error/alert code; the manual lists codes for sensor, pressure, flow, network and Wi-Fi faults.

integration.summary: Pick BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP as BAS Type at the control and set the device ID (plus MAC and baud for MS/TP, or port and BBMD for IP). Set Remote Setpoint Max at the control to cap what the BMS may write, then write AV 0 for the outlet temperature. Everything else is read-only monitoring.
integration.enable: No separate enable point. Selecting a BAS Type in the BAS menu exposes the Remote Setpoint Max setting, which caps the setpoint the BMS can write to AV 0.
setup: BAS Type: Off, Modbus RTU, BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP.
MS/TP: MAC 0-127, baud 9600-115200, plus a user-defined BACnet name.
IP: UDP port 0-65535; optional BBMD foreign device registration with IP, port and time.
gotchas: The manual warns that outlet temperatures above 110 °F need point-of-use mixing valves; set Remote Setpoint Max with that in mind.
No segmentation support per the PICS.
